description: List the references of one document and whether each target exists: dmRef (all contexts: brexDmRef, applicCrossRefTableRef, pmEntry, body), pmRef, ICN (graphic/@infoEntityIdent via the DOCTYPE ENTITY declaration to a file), internalRef (ids in the same document) and applicRefId (applic ids or referencedApplicGroupRef/applicRef). Unresolved references carry a reason (not-found, no-entity-declaration, file-not-found, no-such-id, no-csdb). dmRef to modelIdentCode "S1000D" point to the specification itself and are listed separately.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for referenced data modules, publication modules, ICN files and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; BREX is also searched under S1000D_SPEC_DIR). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

includeResolved.description: Also list resolved references with the file they resolve to (default false; counts are always returned).

path.description: File path of the data module (or PM) to check.

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: check_references
